metadata.title: Chevy Avalanche Replacement Remote Programming 2002 2006
metadata.description:
Visit us at http://www.carandtruckremotes.com/


Programming instructions for a Chevy Avalanche ( steps how program a keyless entry remote) below 

IMPORTANT: Before entering programming mode, have in possession all of the Chevy Avalanche remote transmitters you will be using on the vehicle. Once you program the transmitter, all previous codes will be erased from the memory if not reprogrammed during the same programming procedure. The other transmitters will not be functional until you program the transmitters again with new remote. 

1. Close all Avalanche doors. 

2. Insert the key into the ignition. 

3. Hold down the power UNLOCK button on the driver's door panel and -continue to hold down until instructed to release. 

4. Perform steps 5 through 8 in fairly rapid succession. 

5. Turn the ignition switch to the ON position (as far as you can go without starting the engine). 

6. Turn the ignition switch to the OFF position. 

7. Turn the ignition switch to the ON position. 

8. Turn the ignition switch to the OFF position. 

9. Release the power unlock button on the door panel. The vehicle will lock and unlock the doors automatically to confirm remote programing or learning mode. 

10. Hold down the LOCK and UNLOCK buttons on the remote transmitter simultaneously until the door locks and unlocks. This step may take up to 30 seconds. 

11. Repeat the previous step for each additional car transmitter (including any existing transmitters). 

12. Turn the ignition switch to the ON position in order to exit the transmitter programming mode.

summary.brief: A man demonstrates how to program an additional keyless‑entry remote for a Chevrolet Avalanche.
summary.detailed: The video begins with a title slide naming the Chevrolet Avalanche 2002‑2006 remote tutorial, followed by a shot of the presenter, a man in a black jacket, seated in the driver’s seat. He closes all doors and windows, inserts the ignition key, and holds down the unlock button on the driver‑door panel. He then turns the key on‑off‑on‑off as instructed, releases the unlock button and watches the doors lock and unlock, indicating entry into programming mode. He presses and holds the remote’s lock and unlock buttons together for several seconds until the doors lock and unlock again, repeating the step for each existing remote. After programming the new remote, he turns the ignition to the ON position to exit the procedure, tests the newly programmed remote, confirms it works, and ends the video with a thank‑you and the Car & Truck Remotes logo and website advertisement.

He opens a small pouch, removes a black remote that is still wrapped in clear plastic and places the remote on the passenger‑side console. He then closes the driver’s door, rolls the window up, and presses and holds the unlock button on the door panel. While keeping the button held, he turns the ignition key to the ON position, back to OFF, and repeats the ON‑OFF cycle once more, causing a bright white illumination at the top of the ignition. He releases the unlock button and the doors automatically lock and unlock, indicating entry into programming mode. He next presses the lock and unlock buttons on the remote simultaneously and holds them for several seconds until a clinking sound is heard and the doors lock and unlock again, confirming the remote has been programmed. He finishes by showing the car key first still wrapped in plastic and then the bare key. Throughout the segment a faint glow can be seen under the vehicle on the right side, the interior is grey with dark wooden trim, and outside the window a large white van, two houses, trees and a brown sky with green treetops are visible.
